title: Ancillary Charges List for Assisted Living Residents
content:
Two ancillary prices of the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement are the same at every care level (US dollars):

| Ancillary charge | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Guest meal in the assisted living dining room, per meal | 12.95 | 12.95 | 12.95 | 12.95 | 12.95 | 12.95 |
| Long-term care insurer direct billing administration fee, per calendar month, while Larkspur bills the resident's long-term care insurer directly under an assignment of benefits | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |

The guest meal price is per meal served; a hypothetical family of three guests at one lunch makes three guest meals, 38.85 in all. The administration fee is a monthly figure and applies only to a residency on which direct billing of a long-term care insurer is recorded.
